g.text: Sidebar slides in over the content (☰ or swipe from the left edge)
Thm. α ∈ End(V), V f.d. over ℂ. Then ∃ basis
in which [α] = diag(J₁, …, Jᵣ), Jᵢ Jordan blocks,
unique up to order of blocks.
# blocks with eigenvalue λ = n(α − λι)
# blocks of size ≥ k = n((α−λι)ᵏ) − n((α−λι)ᵏ⁻¹)
